comment: Runs 010-012 (review account, cites P-0034): two A particles at rest, T = 1.0, tracker only, sample_dt 0.005. Separations 3.01 (010), 3.25 (012) and 3.49 (011), all inside r_range [3.0, 3.5]. Species A, N = 2, T <= 1.0 are inside the claim's domain; predict() raises no error. Judge-style RMSE/L against each run: 0.00491, 0.00523, 0.00507, all below the bar 3 x 0.007 = 0.021. Verdict replicated for claim c1 (A-A) only. Claim c2 (C-C, P-0034-c2) is not tested by these runs and this review does not cover it. Limits: the judged metric sits at the noise floor, so these runs test the stated bound, not the node values to 1 to 3 per cent. Not tested: separations below 3.0 (where the pair reaches contact inside T = 1), durations above 1.0.
